names.deprecation: gpt-image-1 dies 2026-10-23; gpt-image-2 is the sole OpenAI image target

structures.paragraph: PRIMARY — cohesive descriptive paragraph, each element paired with its details; minimal, descriptive-paragraph, instruction-style and tag-based prompts all work
structures.labeled_sections: OPTIONAL for complexity — Subject / Style / Composition / Color Palette / Lighting / Mood / Additional Details
structures.json: NOT recommended — structured layout lives in the engine's internal IR and renders to prose (SOURCE_TRUTH §1)
structures.complexity_rule: Break complex requests into a series of simpler prompts; start simple (single clean subject, simple background) and iterate

text_rendering.quotes: Put literal text in DOUBLE quotes
text_rendering.letter_spelling: Spell tricky words letter-by-letter to fix garbled text
text_rendering.fonts: Simple modern sans-serif fonts for infographics
text_rendering.keep_lean: Keep text lean — excessive text is warned against for cost/clutter only; NO numeric word limits exist
text_rendering.quality_high: Set quality=high for text-heavy visuals — improves text rendering accuracy

exclusions.positive_first: State what you want: 'a bright, sunny sky' beats 'not a cloudy sky'

references.syntax: Address inputs by ordinal + role: 'the first image… as the background', 'the second image as reference for the character'
references.batch_edits: Edits replace the ENTIRE image each call — batch ALL changes into ONE edit call, never sequential
references.blending: To blend multiple refs: merge into one image first, or explicitly instruct combining elements from all images
references.world_knowledge: Well-known logos/objects need NO reference image — name them instead of describing

sizes.custom: Arbitrary W×H: both edges multiples of 16, ratio no greater than 3:1, total pixels 655,360–8,294,400, max edge under 3840px
sizes.experimental: Above 2560x1440 (3,686,400 px) officially experimental — results more variable; 4K 3840x2160 supported, round to 3824x2144 if an edge must stay under 3840

params.quality: low/medium/high/auto — low for fast iteration, high for final output and text-heavy work
params.input_fidelity: high/low on edits — high recommended for fine-grained edits like text rendering; costs more input tokens
params.masks: Alpha-channel masks (transparent = edit here), PNG, same dimensions

ui_mockups.world_knowledge: Lean on the model's world knowledge of real products

localization.workflow: Generate English text first, then localize via edit with a reference screenshot
localization.text_layer: Instruct 'text layer fully editable' and 'translations that fit naturally within the design'

camera.generic: Generic camera/lens/lighting mention is endorsed for photoreal work
camera.no_incantations: Exact lens specs are 'interpreted loosely' — use them for high-level look, not physical simulation
